tips.title: Stay centered in every gunfight
tips.source: JGOD (top Warzone YouTuber), with pro Tommey as his example
tips.overview: Keep your crosshair lined up with where the enemy will appear before the fight starts, instead of correcting after contact.
tips.why: JGOD says even a tiny correction when you are off-centre can be enough to lose a gunfight. He points to top pro Tommey as an example of how good centering can even cover for mistakes.
tips.how: Pre-aim common angles and doorways, and keep your crosshair at head height while you move. Benefit: you start fights already on target, which JGOD says helps you win more gunfights and raise your K/D.

tips.title: Check the minimap constantly
tips.overview: Glance at the minimap far more often than feels natural.
tips.why: JGOD says frequent minimap checks let you spot enemy movement early, so you can plan rotations and avoid most ambushes.
tips.how: Look at it every few seconds and before every move, then rotate away from enemy activity. Benefit: safer, more efficient rotations and fewer surprise fights.

tips.title: Take high ground and save killstreaks for the end
tips.overview: In the final circles, choose high ground and solid cover, and keep your killstreaks for the end.
tips.why: JGOD describes the late-game circle as hard to read, so positioning and awareness decide most wins. Killstreaks such as Precision Strike and UAV are most useful when few squads remain.
tips.how: Move early to a high, covered spot, then use UAV and Precision Strike to pressure the squads that are left. Benefit: you control the sightlines and can corner the remaining players.

tips.title: Plan your final-circle positions in advance
tips.source: Liam “Jukeyz” James (pro Warzone player), via Red Bull
tips.overview: Before the last circles close, imagine the situations you could end up in and choose your spot to match.
tips.why: Jukeyz says he thinks through the possible situations for the final circles so that his positioning is as strong as it can be.
tips.how: Early in the match, picture where enemies could come from and pick a spot that covers those angles. Benefit: you enter the final circles with a plan instead of reacting.

tips.title: Use a Tactical (flipped) button layout
tips.source: Aydan (top-earning pro Warzone player), reported by ONE Esports
tips.overview: Aydan uses the Tactical Flipped layout: aim with L1 and shoot with R1.
tips.why: ONE Esports reports that many pros and streamers use this layout because the bumpers give a more tactile response than the default triggers.
tips.how: Set the Tactical preset, turn on the flip option, then practise in a private match. Benefit: quicker, more tactile aim and fire inputs. If it feels worse, go back to your old layout.
tips.nav: Settings (gear icon) → Controller → Inputs → Button Layout Preset, plus the Flip L1/L2 and R1/R2 option. Names can vary slightly by platform and version.

tips.title: Keep horizontal and vertical sensitivity equal
tips.source: Settings of 33 top Warzone players, reported by Charlie INTEL
tips.overview: Set your horizontal and vertical stick sensitivity to the same value.
tips.why: A compilation of the controller settings of 33 of Warzone’s best players, reported by Charlie INTEL, shows that almost every pro uses the same value for both.
tips.how: Pick one value you can control and apply it to both, then change them together in small steps. Benefit: your aim feels consistent in every direction.
tips.nav: Settings (gear icon) → Controller → Aiming → Horizontal Stick Sensitivity and Vertical Stick Sensitivity.

tips.title: Raise your Field of View
tips.overview: Aydan plays on a Field of View of 105 (from his published settings), so more of the battlefield is on screen.
tips.why: A wider FOV shows more around you, so you spot enemies sooner. JGOD points out that other settings need adjusting to get the full benefit of a higher FOV.
tips.how: Raise it in steps towards 105 and test in a private match. Aydan also keeps ADS Field of View on Affected. Benefit: better peripheral awareness. A very high FOV can lower performance on older PCs, so check your frame rate.
tips.nav: Settings (gear icon) → Graphics → View → Field of View.

tips.title: Switch off blur, depth of field and film grain
tips.source: Aydan, reported by ONE Esports and Gfinity
tips.overview: Aydan turns off World Motion Blur, Weapon Motion Blur and Depth of Field, and sets Film Grain to 0.00.
tips.why: Cutting these effects removes visual clutter and keeps the image sharp while you track targets. Aydan’s graphics setup is aimed at smoother gameplay.
tips.how: Disable each effect and set Film Grain to 0. Benefit: a cleaner image and easier target tracking.
tips.nav: Settings (gear icon) → Graphics, then check the Details & Textures and post-processing sections. These options are mainly on PC, and tab names can vary by platform and version.
